programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.desc: When the book shop hosts a mystery weekend, recluse hit author Clare Beckman announces her retirement, DA Cassie is hit by what may well be a failed attempt. Charming new lawyer Scott Tyler dates both friends. The weapon was registered by oldest attending local Dorothy, who rather risks arrest by the chief then accepting help or disclosing the truth, including about her ex Derek. Later, Clare mysteriously dumps fiancee Grant and dies from bee poison, which only works due to her allergy which few people knew about.

But at the urging of his best friend, he spontaneously proposes to a dissatisfied waitress named Katie and an innocent dare evolves into the kind of love that both have been looking for all along.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Cornwall, 1786, hungry Mary Broad is sentenced to death for stealing a lady's picnic but 'mercifully' allowed to join for life first governor Phillip's founding shipload to start a penal colony at Botany Bay in New South Wales. On board, she fails to be recruited as 'comfort maid' by gentleman marine infantry Lieutenant Ralph Clarke, but gets the job to save her after near drowning, then loses it again by arrogance and becomes pregnant by male convict William 'Will' Bryant. Pioneer life is a relative relief, especially for able fisherman Will's privileged crew. Harvests are disastrous and Mary becomes Ralph's lover, but only to steal his key for Will's elaborate escape party preparations.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: The escapees' party has got away in one boat, ill-prepared, and after bitter bickering decides to risk sailing to the Dutch Indies. Despite lack of wind, they finally reach Timor. There they pretend to be shipwrecked rich Englishmen and live in luxury on credit for years. When lieutenant Clark passes the island on his way home, he discovers the escaped criminals. William is killed resisting arrest, the rest caught and put on trial in London. The public and press sympathize with the adventurers.

programme.desc: Twin sisters are keen to find dates ahead of a family party. But in a classic case of mistaken identity, they unknowingly date the same man, and invite him to meet the family on the same day.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: Murder Without Conviction
programme.desc: One day after school, Morgan is talking to one of her friends, and the subject of horseback riding comes up. Morgan has never done it before and thinks it's easy, so she decides to take some lessons. Simply put, she's horrible. Morgan quits, but the jersey won't let her do that. It transforms her into a gymnist. Domnique Dawes reminds her of how she never gives up after only one try at something. Morgan returns as a new person, and finds a little success the second time around. Meanwhile, Coleman, Nick, and Elliot all need a new pair of shoes, but have absolutely no money. Nick's father, Larry, offers them a job at his office, ""Lighter than Air"". While there, Coleman finds some really cool clothes, Elliot finds office supplies, and Nick builds an enorous sandwich. Obviously, they didn't do their job. However, they meet Jim Harbaugh, star quarterback for the San Diego Chargers (at the time) and Larry lets the three each get a pair of new shoes for no apparent reason.

programme.title: The Inspectors

programme.title: Ambulance Girl
programme.desc: Comedy drama directed by and starring Kathy Bates. When paralysing phobias threaten the personal and professional life of a food writer (Bates), she decides to venture off in a completely different direction. As a volunteer paramedic, she finally discovers the perfect way to help herself by helping others.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. For the lonely Gerta, her only joy is her friendship with a handsome young man, Kai. Then one night, an unknown guest arrives at the inn, dressed in furs and diamonds. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: A corporate exec and family man is accused of participating in a war crime 30 years earlier during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: J.T. changes tactics by attempting to appease or in some other way prevent anyone with the motive to kill him from getting a chance to do it on the fateful evening.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: Physics professor J.T. Neumeyer finds a briefcase that contains a file predicting his own murder in five days.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Maccabi" - "Hapoel"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Experience a year in Yellowstone, the worlds first national park. Meet remarkable wildlife, from the steadfast Wapiti wolves and resilient bison to playful grizzly cubs. Discover the parks indigenous heritage, ecological diversity, and geological wonders. Home to the largest collection of geysers on the planet, this American trailblazer shapes how we value and safeguard our most precious lands.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Delve beneath the surface of the largest habitat on Earth - our oceans - to uncover a world of extraordinary extremes from crushing depths to stormy coasts and vast blue deserts to crowded reefs. Oceans are dynamic environments where animals must adapt to life of constant change. Discover how seals fend off sharks; how turtles risk their lives to create their next generation; and how ingenious orca fight to survive in the face of ever-increasing competition.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Step inside the most frigid habitat known to Earth - the poles. Here, the planet's ultimate survivalists include whale-hunting polar bears, leopard-seal dodging penguins and a pack of Arctic wolves that bring down a pair of musk oxen. Polar species have evolved bodies and behaviours that help them combat the intense hostility of their habitats. But now, their world is changing so fast - literally breaking apart under their feet - and their resilience will be tested beyond the extreme.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Life in the African bush is a game of survival, for both hunter and hunted. Add babies to the mix and you'll see astounding feats of courage as mothers risk life and limb to protect their young. programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Documentary series featuring fearsome fights between the biggest and the baddest animals on planet. Watch the animals fighting for their food, territory, rights and life. Follow the drama and adrenaline of the toughest and fearcest fights in savannah, jungles and water. It is an ultimate survival with no rules whatsoever. Uncover the extraordinary motivations and strategies used by the animal world.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: "Animal Fight Club: Power Struggles" reveals how the even the most epic battles can be won or lost in a split second. In the world of wild animal fights, nothing is ever certain. programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The first part explains the beginnings of the national parks in Austria, which were characterized by the visions of a few pioneers and the civil disobedience of many. One remembers the occupation of a floodplain in the conflict over the construction of a power station or protests against building a cannon firing range. But of course, this production also knows how to inspire with fascinating nature stories and animal shots.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The second part focuses on the challenges of the future: How do the national parks deal with invasive species from outside and what success stories can be reported? For instance, in the Hohe Tauern National Park the previously extinct ibexes and bearded vultures have been reintroduced. In the Gesäuse National Park Avalanches created one of the most species-rich habitats, which rare butterflies like the Red Apollo colonize.

programme.title: Wild Hunters
programme.desc: Embark on a spectacular journey around the world in search of nature's deadliest predators. See how mammals, insects, fish, and birds fight for survival using a fascinating combination of hunting strategies.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: As the first national park founded to protect wildlife and ecological richness, the Everglades teems with life above and below water. This land of diversity boasts nine unique ecosystems, each shaped by the wet and dry seasons ebb and flow. Roseate spoonbills, black bears, alligators, bottlenose dolphins and panthers all thrive in the largest subtropical wilderness in North America.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity, all shot with breath-taking brio and the latest technology to reveal the continent and its animals in all its breath-taking glory.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe is a continent of diversity, and its coasts are no exception. From the frozen Arctic Ocean, where polar bears and reindeer battle for survival, to the warm beaches of the Mediterranean, home to pink flamingos and killer corals, Europe's coastline attracts a staggering array of wildlife. It's also the setting for some of the world's most jaw-dropping natural spectacles, including orcas and humpback whales hunting side by side, and wild horses running free on the beaches of the Camargue.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: When Wally uses his magic stick and the letter T to turn a rock into a talking friend named Rockelle, she leads him and Norville on a journey to find a famous treasure. But Bobgoblin is close behind, and he wants that treasure!

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: Super Duper Bunny League
programme.desc: The Super Duper Bunny League is a team of bunnies who defends the world from a gallery of cartoony villains. From fighting sweet-toothed space pirates to lava monsters, they use their superpowers to protect truth, justice, and free time to chill.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: Best & Bester

programme.title: La Liga. Bilbao „Athletic“ - Viljarealio CF
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Bundeslyga. Dortmundo „Borussia" - Lėverkuzeno „Bayer“
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. programme.title: Now You See Me 2 - I maghi del crimine
programme.desc: Torna la banda di illusionisti in un action nel segno della magia con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo, Daniel Radcliffe e i premi Oscar Michael Caine e Morgan Freeman. Ricercati dall'Fbi, I Quattro Cavalieri non resistono alla tentazione di tornare in azione, per smascherare Owen Case, un corrotto magnate della tecnologia. Elaborano un meticoloso piano che li condurra' fino a Macao, in una trappola ideata dal giovane ex socio di Case (Daniel Radcliffe). Per salvare la reputazione e la loro stessa vita, i Cavalieri dovranno mettere in scena un vero e proprio show.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana e Orlando Bloom nel kolossal ispirato al poema omerico. Dopo il rapimento di Elena da parte di Paride, Agamennone guida gli spartani contro i troiani.

programme.desc: Gli YouNuts! dirigono una comedy on the road con Fabio Rovazzi, Lillo, Alessandra Mastronardi e Michela De Rossi. Una app di Car-Sharing riunisce 4 sconosciuti in un viaggio avventuroso.

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Diretto da Craig Gillespie, il financial drama che ripercorre il caso GameStop, l'azienda salvata da un gruppo di investitori amatoriali a discapito di un gruppo di speculatori di Wall Street.

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Gugu Mbatha-Raw in un dramma storico. Guerra civile americana: un contadino si ribella ai soprusi dell'esercito confederato e crea uno stato indipendente.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Il capo perfetto
programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Kate Winslet, vincitrice del Golden Globe, in un dramma coniugale diretto da Sam Mendes, che racconta la crisi di una coppia borghese nell'America degli anni 50.

programme.title: Piccole donne
programme.desc: Rilettura di un classico diretto da Greta Gerwig con Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Laura Dern e Meryl Streep. La storia delle sorelle March nell'America della Guerra Civile. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: Al Pacino nel gangster-movie capolavoro di Brian De Palma, sceneggiato da Oliver Stone. Il rifugiato cubano Tony Montana scala i vertici della malavita e diventa il re del narcotraffico.

programme.title: Bleed - Più forte del destino
programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: Indiana Jones - Speciale - Ep. 304 - Indiana Jones - Speciale
programme.desc: Uno speciale per raccontare le avventure del dottor Jones, l'archeologo piu' famoso del mondo interpretato da Harrison Ford e diretto da Steven Spielberg, dall'1 al 7 maggio su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Padrenostro
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Pierfrancesco Favino, diretto da Claudio Noce in una storia ispirata alla sua vita. Roma, 1976: Valerio assiste all'attentato terroristico ai danni del padre magistrato.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Per qualche dollaro in piu'
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo restaurato della trilogia western di Sergio Leone con Clint Eastwood e Gian Maria Volontè. Due pistoleri braccano un bandito messicano sul quale pende una grossa taglia.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Kate Winslet, vincitrice del Golden Globe, in un dramma coniugale diretto da Sam Mendes, che racconta la crisi di una coppia borghese nell'America degli anni 50.

programme.title: Rob Peace
programme.desc: Un ragazzo geniale, cresciuto da una madre amorevole, mette a repentaglio i propri successi e il proprio futuro per liberare il padre, che è in prigione. Questa sua rischiosa impresa mette alla prova i legami familiari e le ambizioni personali.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al capolavoro diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood con Hilary Swank e Morgan Freeman. Un anziano e burbero allenatore di boxe trasforma una tenace ragazza in una campionessa.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: David Mann, tranquillo commesso, si ritrova imprigionato in un pericoloso gioco al gatto e al topo in autostrada con un mostruoso camion guidato da un misterioso psicopatico.

programme.title: Lansky
programme.desc: Biopic con Harvey Keitel e Sam Worthington. Sotto custodia dell'FBI, l’anziano mafioso bielorusso Meyer Lansky, esponente del ‘Sindacato ebraico’, racconta la sua vita a un giornalista.

programme.title: Il colibrì
programme.desc: Francesca Archibugi dirige Pierfrancesco Favino, Nanni Moretti e Kasia Smutniak, dal romanzo di Sandro Veronesi. La vita di un uomo, fra dure prove e ricordi, a partire dal suo primo amore.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al western di Quentin Tarantino con Christoph Waltz, Jamie Foxx e Leonardo DiCaprio. Uno schiavo nero riacquista la liberta' e corre a salvare anche sua moglie.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Dante
programme.desc: Biopic con Sergio Castellitto e Alessandro Sperduti, diretti da Pupi Avati. 30 anni dopo la morte di Dante Alighieri, il Boccaccio ne ripercorre la vita in un viaggio da Firenze e Ravenna.

programme.title: Il Concorso
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Gugu Mbatha-Raw nel biopic su una storica battaglia femminista. Londra, 1970: il ‘Women's Liberation Movement’ irrompe in diretta televisiva durante il concorso per l’elezione di Miss Mondo in segno di protesta contro la strumentalizzazione delle donne.

programme.title: Blade Runner : Director's Cut
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo venturo un investigatore ha il compito di eliminare un gruppo di androidi assassini in fuga dal loro artefice, ma nel corso della propria ricerca viene a conoscenza di una verità terrificante.

programme.title: Conclave
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe all'acclamato film di Edward Berger ambientato nel mondo della Chiesa con Ralph Fiennes, Stanley Tucci, Sergio Castellitto e Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al western di Quentin Tarantino con Christoph Waltz, Jamie Foxx e Leonardo DiCaprio. Uno schiavo nero riacquista la liberta' e corre a salvare anche sua moglie.

programme.title: War - La guerra desiderata
programme.desc: War-dramedy di Gianni Zanasi con Edoardo Leo, Miriam Leone, Giuseppe Battiston. La guerra tra Italia e Spagna unisce le vite di un allevatore di vongole e della figlia di un politico.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: Un Film Fatto Per Bene
programme.desc: Quando le riprese del film di Franco Maresco su Carmelo Bene vengono interrotte, il regista accusa la produzione di 'filmicidio' prima di sparire. Umberto Cantone interviene interrogando coloro che vi avevano partecipato, per ricostruire la vicenda.

programme.title: Indiana Jones - Speciale - Ep. 304 - Indiana Jones - Speciale
programme.desc: Uno speciale per raccontare le avventure del dottor Jones, l'archeologo piu' famoso del mondo interpretato da Harrison Ford e diretto da Steven Spielberg, dall'1 al 7 maggio su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Malcolm X
programme.desc: Denzel Washington, vincitore a Berlino, interpreta l’attivista per i diritti degli afroamericani nel biopic di Spike Lee che ne racconta la storia dall’infanzia fino all’assassinio.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: Jesse Eisenberg, Ed Harris e Clemence Poesy nel biopic su Marcel Marceau. Nella Francia occupata dai nazisti, il mimo si unisce alla Resistenza per salvare centinaia di bambini ebrei.

programme.title: Vita Privata
programme.desc: Una psichiatra piuttosto nota viene a sapere della morte di una delle sue pazienti. Presto, si convince che si tratti di un omicidio e decide di portare avanti la propria indagine per scoprire la verità.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al western di Quentin Tarantino con Christoph Waltz, Jamie Foxx e Leonardo DiCaprio. Uno schiavo nero riacquista la liberta' e corre a salvare anche sua moglie.

programme.title: Il padrino
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Francis F. Coppola, con Marlon Brando e Al Pacino. Dopo l'attentato al padre, Mike comincia l'ascesa nella malavita a capo della famiglia Corleone.

programme.title: Il Padrino - Parte II
programme.desc: Al Pacino, Robert De Niro e Diane Keaton nel sequel premiato con 6 Oscar. Nel 1901 il siciliano Don Vito raggiunge gli Stati Uniti e getta le fondamenta del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Il Padrino: Epilogo - La morte di Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Joaquin Phoenix riveste i panni del folle personaggio della DC Comics in uno sbalorditivo sequel con Lady Gaga. Internato nel manicomio di Arkham in attesa del processo per i crimini commessi, Arthur Fleck si innamora di Lee Quinzel, una paziente affascinata dalla figura del Joker.

programme.title: Indiana Jones - Speciale - Ep. 304 - Indiana Jones - Speciale
programme.desc: Uno speciale per raccontare le avventure del dottor Jones, l'archeologo piu' famoso del mondo interpretato da Harrison Ford e diretto da Steven Spielberg, dall'1 al 7 maggio su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: Paul Walker e Vin Diesel nel primo entusiasmante capitolo della saga. Un agente di Los Angeles si infiltra nel mondo delle corse clandestine per smascherare una banda di rapinatori.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: John Singleton dirige Paul Walker nel primo sequel della saga. Un ex poliziotto si infiltra sotto falsa identita' nella gang di un narcotrafficante con l'obiettivo di incastrarlo.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: Justin Lin dirige Lucas Black nel terzo capitolo della saga action. Per evitare il carcere, un giovane pilota di gare clandestine si trasferisce a Tokyo, ma finisce nel giro della Yakuza.

programme.title: Fast & Furious - Solo parti originali
programme.desc: Quarto capitolo della saga con il ritorno di Vin Diesel, Paul Walker e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic Toretto torna a Los Angeles per vendicare un'amica e ritrova l'agente O'Conner.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sui film della spettacolare saga action Fast & Furious, disponibile su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Paul Walker, Vin Diesel e Dwayne Johnson nel quinto capitolo della saga action. Brasile: Brian e Dominic riuniscono il team per organizzare un ultimo colpo (USA 2011).

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della saga action con Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, 'The Rock' e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic e Brian riuniscono la vecchia squadra per contrastare una banda di piloti criminali.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Vin Diesel, 'The Rock', Jason Statham e il compianto Paul Walker nel settimo capitolo della saga. Dominic e compagni devono difendersi da un killer deciso a vendicare il fratello.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Tornano i muscoli e i motori della saga blockbuster in un iperbolico ottavo capitolo che schiera Vin Diesel, Jason Statham, Dwayne Johnson, Kurt Russell e il premio Oscar Charlize Theron. Un'affascinante dark lady, Cipher, usa l'arma del ricatto e della seduzione per convincere Dominique Toretto a tradire i suoi amici e a lavorare per lei. Dom entra cosi' nel mondo del terrorismo internazionale: la prima missione, a Berlino, lo vedra' impossessarsi di un ordigno a spese dell'ex compagno di squadra Hobbes. e' solo il punto di partenza di un giro intorno al mondo ad alto tasso di pericolosita'.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham e Idris Elba nel primo spin-off della saga. Gli agenti Hobbs e Shaw si alleano per fermare un terrorista che minaccia di decimare la razza umana con un virus.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale

programme.title: I viaggiatori
programme.desc: Avventuroso viaggio nel tempo targato Sky Original. Un gruppo di adolescenti alla ricerca di un fratello scomparso, viene catapultato nella Roma del 1939 sull'orlo del conflitto mondiale.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Fiaba di arti marziali con un simpatico e goloso panda. Secondo un'antica profezia, Po sarebbe il prescelto 'Guerriero del Dragone'. Si affida così a un severo maestro di Kung Fu.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: Il marchio DreamWorks su un film d'animazione tratto dai libri a fumetti per bambini di Dav Pilkey. Feriti in un incidente, un cane poliziotto e il suo collega umano sono sottoposti a un intervento che li fonde insieme. Nasce Dog Man, creatura ibrida al servizio della città contro un malvagio gatto arancione.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro
programme.desc: Michael J.Fox nel primo capitolo della trilogia cult di Robert Zemeckis. Anni '80: con una macchina del tempo, l'adolescente Marty McFly finisce nel 1955 e incontra i suoi futuri genitori.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro - Parte II
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della trilogia di Robert Zemeckis con Michael J. Fox e Christopher Lloyd. Marty e Doc volano nel 2015, innescando una serie di eventi che cambieranno anche il passato.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: Indiana Jones - Speciale - Ep. 304 - Indiana Jones - Speciale
programme.desc: Uno speciale per raccontare le avventure del dottor Jones, l'archeologo piu' famoso del mondo interpretato da Harrison Ford e diretto da Steven Spielberg, dall'1 al 7 maggio su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Qua la zampa 2 - Un amico è per sempre
programme.desc: Commovente sequel con Dennis Quaid e Kathryn Prescott. Costretto a separarsi dalla sua piccola amica umana, il cane Bailey decide che nelle sue prossime vite la trovera' e la proteggera'.

programme.title: I viaggiatori
programme.desc: Avventuroso viaggio nel tempo targato Sky Original. Un gruppo di adolescenti alla ricerca di un fratello scomparso, viene catapultato nella Roma del 1939 sull'orlo del conflitto mondiale.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - Amici per sempre
programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: Vicky e il suo cucciolo
programme.desc: Toccante storia di amicizia sui monti del Cantal. Dopo la morte della madre, la piccola Victoria si e' chiusa nel mutismo. Un cucciolo di lupo le restituira' la voce e il sorriso.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Il cacciatore e la regina di ghiaccio
programme.desc: Prequel di 'Biancaneve e il cacciatore' con Charlize Theron, Chris Hemsworth e Jessica Chastain. Un cacciatore e una guerriera difendono la Terra incantata da due streghe maligne.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro - Parte II
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della trilogia di Robert Zemeckis con Michael J. Fox e Christopher Lloyd. Marty e Doc volano nel 2015, innescando una serie di eventi che cambieranno anche il passato.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Sing 2 - Sempre più forte
programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro - Parte III
programme.desc: Si chiude nel Far West la trilogia cult con Michael J. Fox per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Marty viaggia indietro nel tempo fino al 1885 per salvare la vita dell'amico Doc Brown.

programme.title: E.T. L'extra-terrestre
programme.desc: 4 Oscar all'emozionante capolavoro di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un bambino protegge dagli scienziati un alieno rimasto sulla Terra e lo aiuta a tornare sul suo pianeta.

programme.title: Il cacciatore e la regina di ghiaccio
programme.desc: Prequel di 'Biancaneve e il cacciatore' con Charlize Theron, Chris Hemsworth e Jessica Chastain. Un cacciatore e una guerriera difendono la Terra incantata da due streghe maligne.

programme.title: Me contro Te: Il film - Vacanze in Transilvania
programme.desc: Sofi', Lui' e i loro amici volano in Transilvania per impedire a Viperiana e alla banda di Malefici di impossessarsi di un potente diamante custodito nel castello del piu' temuto dei vampiri: il Conte Dracula.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Lassie torna a casa
programme.desc: Avventuroso reboot del film datato 1943, che riporta sullo schermo il cane più famoso del cinema. Finito in una famiglia che non esita a maltrattarlo, Lassie riesce a scappare e affronta molti pericoli pur di ricongiungersi con il suo affezionato padrone Florian.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
